headline: Full hosting mode can run the tunnel client, and the Cloud host page shows the proxy lines to add
summary: Build 503 lets the Supervisor run the tunnel client for full hosting mode, so Set up can start the provider's own sign-in and then create the tunnel. Once the tunnel runs, the Cloud host page shows the exact proxy lines to add, with a Copy button. Home Assistant still has to be restarted by hand, and the page does not edit the configuration. Set up did not work in a real run, because a missing tunnel container was treated as an error. That is fixed in build 509, so Set up does not work on this build.
summary_yue: 503 版俾 Supervisor 運行隧道程式，完整託管模式嘅「設定」而家可以啟動供應商自己嘅登入，登入之後先建立隧道。隧道運行緊嘅時候，雲端主機頁面會顯示要加入嘅代理設定，有複製掣。Home Assistant 仍然要人手重新啟動，頁面亦唔會改設定。真機運行時「設定」失敗，原因係隧道容器未存在時被當作錯誤；呢個問題已經喺 509 版修正，所以呢版嘅「設定」唔會成功。

highlights.title: Full hosting mode can start the tunnel client, not only explain it
highlights.what: Until this build, the Cloud host page could only explain full hosting mode, because nothing started the tunnel. The Supervisor now runs the tunnel client as a managed container with a pinned official image and no published ports. Set up starts the provider's own sign-in, shows only the sign-in address, and refuses any address that is not on the provider's login domain. After sign-in, the tunnel is created and runs against Core's internal address. Errors are short fixed reasons. Set up did not work in a real run and is fixed in build 509.
highlights.what_yue: 直到呢版之前，雲端主機頁面淨係可以解釋完整託管模式，因為冇嘢會真係啟動隧道。而家 Supervisor 會以一個鎖定版本嘅官方映像運行隧道程式，唔開任何連接埠。「設定」會啟動供應商自己嘅登入，淨係顯示登入網址，唔係供應商登入網域嘅網址一律拒絕。登入完成之後先會建立隧道，並且對住 Core 嘅內部位址運行。真機運行時「設定」失敗，已經喺 509 版修正。
highlights.why: A page that promised remote access in one click had no working part behind the button.
try: Read the risk note at the top of the Cloud host page.
Press Set up, then Next step to move through the five steps.
See that sign-in happens at the provider, and nothing is stored here.

highlights.title: The Cloud host page shows the exact proxy lines to add
highlights.what: While the tunnel runs, the page shows the three lines to add to the Home Assistant configuration, with a Copy button and a plain sentence that Home Assistant must be restarted. The page does not edit the configuration itself. The sign-in step now says what really happens: sign in at the provider and the page moves on by itself. Remove says that the address record at the provider may remain.
highlights.what_yue: 隧道運行緊嗰陣，頁面會顯示要加入 Home Assistant 設定嘅三行字，有複製掣，同埋一句講明要重新啟動 Home Assistant 嘅說明。頁面唔會自己改設定。登入嗰一步而家講明真正會發生乜嘢：喺供應商度登入之後，頁面會自己行落去。移除就會講明供應商嗰邊嘅位址紀錄可能仲喺度。
highlights.why: The old page waved vaguely at a tunnel address, which left the owner to work out the lines alone.
try: Press Start the tunnel and read the three lines that appear.
Press Copy the lines and read the restart note under them.
Press Stop the tunnel and see the lines go away.
